---
title: "One-Way ANOVA Using PlantGrowth Dataset"
output: html_document
date: "2026-04-24"
---

```{r}
data(PlantGrowth)
head(PlantGrowth)
```
**Raincoud Plot**
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggdist)

ggplot(PlantGrowth,
       aes(x = group,
           y = weight,
           fill = group)) +

# Raw data points
geom_jitter(
  width = .08,
  size = 3,
  alpha = .8
) +

# Boxplots
geom_boxplot(
  width = .18,
  alpha = .6,
  outlier.shape = NA
) +

# Half violin ("cloud")
stat_halfeye(
  adjust = .5,
  width = .6,
  justification = -0.35,
  point_colour = NA,
  alpha = .5
) +

labs(
  title = "Raincloud Plot",
  x = "",
  y = "Plant Weight"
) +

theme_classic(base_size = 16)
```
**Shapiro Test**
```{r}
by(PlantGrowth$weight, PlantGrowth$group, shapiro.test)
```

**Descriptive Statistics**
```{r}
aggregate(weight ~ group,
          data=PlantGrowth,
          function(x)c(
            Mean=mean(x),
            SD=sd(x),
            N=length(x)
          ))
```

**Levene's Test**
```{r}
library(car)
leveneTest(weight ~ group, data = PlantGrowth)
```
**One-Way ANOVA**

```{r}
anova_model <- aov(weight ~ group, data=PlantGrowth)
summary(anova_model)
```

**Post Hoc Test**

```{r}
TukeyHSD(anova_model)
```
